title: Improving Reduced-Order Rotating Detonation Engine Models with Data Assimilation and Machine Learning
summary: Rotating detonation engines (RDEs) exhibit strongly nonlinear, multiscale wave dynamics that set the observed thermal field. High-fidelity simulations (DNS/LES) resolve these structures but remain computationally prohibitive, while low-order models such as the one-dimensional Koch-Kutz model capture circumferential wave motion yet lack the expressivity for high-frequency content.
